# yoyosup News — Multi-Platform Attention Map & Daily Intersection
> Real-time consensus and news rank tracking across Google, Bing, YouTube, X, Polymarket, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram. Free, no account, privacy-first.

## Primary News Resources & Tools

- [Top Stories (Daily Intersection)](https://news.yoyosup.com/): Real-time surging news topics ranked across 8 major search, video, social, and prediction market platforms.
- [Intersection Search](https://news.yoyosup.com/search): Rank map search comparing how any topic ranks on Google, Bing, YouTube, X, Polymarket, and TikTok.
- [My Feed (MyNews)](https://news.yoyosup.com/my): Custom local topic board saved entirely on-device without an account or login.
- [Safety & Verification](https://news.yoyosup.com/safety): Cross-referenced fake news, phishing, and scam text warning checks backed by YoyoTools ScamCheck.

## Network Siblings

- [YoyoTools](https://www.yoyosup.com/tools/): Free on-device scam checkers, link safety tests, and utilities.
- [YoyoFinance](https://finance.yoyosup.com/): Real-time Treasury rates, mortgage averages, forex, crypto context, and stock quotes.
